error_chain: Spring Kafka's ListenerConsumer poll loop in KafkaMessageListenerContainer accumulates pending acks based on ContainerProperties.ackMode (BATCH, RECORD, etc.)
Kafka's ConsumerCoordinator detects rebalance and invokes ConsumerRebalanceListener.onPartitionsRevoked before assigning new partitions
With ackMode=BATCH, Spring defers commit until after the listener batch returns; if rebalance fires mid-batch, the deferred acks are discarded when the partition is revoked
Kafka's ConsumerCoordinator commits any acked offsets in onPartitionsRevoked, but Spring's pending ack queue is unflushed, so those records appear unacked and are reprocessed by the new owner
trigger_conditions: ackMode is set to BATCH (default) and a consumer group rebalance fires while a batch is still being acked
Spring's pending-ack queue has not been flushed to KafkaConsumer.commitSync by the time onPartitionsRevoked runs
Kafka's ConsumerCoordinator commits only what it sees in its own in-memory offset map; Spring's queued acks never made it there

expected_answer.error_origin: Spring Kafka's ackMode=BATCH deferring commit until end-of-batch, racing with Kafka's ConsumerCoordinator.onPartitionsRevoked
expected_answer.bypass_reason: Kafka's ConsumerCoordinator commits only what KafkaConsumer knows about; Spring's deferred ack queue is invisible to it
expected_answer.correct_config: Set ackMode=RECORD or MANUAL_IMMEDIATE so each ack is committed to Kafka before the next poll, eliminating the rebalance race window; alternatively, hook ConsumerRebalanceListener.onPartitionsRevoked to flush Spring's pending queue
